messages:
maria: FYI - onboarding sampleapp hit a weird embed/rerank flow: after an auth refresh replay we sometimes get `vectors: null` in the response and the sampleapp crashes. Repro notes incoming.

sam: Oof. Which SDK + versions?

maria: JS SDK v1.6.2, server infer v2026.03.16. Payload (sanitized): ```json {\"model\":\"open-embedding-small\",\"inputs\":[\"short doc\",\"another\"],\"batcher\":{\"max_batch_size\":8,\"pad_to_max\":true} } ```

jess: Two things we see often: 1) JS helper uses `vectors` field name while Python/Rust use `embeddings`. 2) The batcher helper pads with string "0" historically which breaks numeric parsers.

ashok: Logs show auth loop: `401 -> REFRESH -> 429 -> immediate retry -> 200 (vectors:null)`. The helper replays request without backoff, causing near-duplicate requests. Server collapses and returns placeholder null for one slot.

maria: Raw response: ```json {\"status\":\"ok\",\"request_id\":\"r_123abc\",\"vectors\":[null,[0,0,0]],\"meta\":{\"model\":\"open-embedding-small\"} } ```

sam: Mixed envelope shapes + name mismatch will break sampleapp plumbing.

jess: Proposed short-term fixes: normalize JS SDK to `embeddings` (accept both server-side), change pad to numeric 0.0, and add jittered backoff to auth-replay. I can own the JS mapping + padding fix.

ashok: I'll add an ops note to temporarily disable auto-replay until backoff lands. Workaround: set `batcher.pad_to_max=false` and disable helper retry. Slower but stable.

maria: I added a tiny repro in repos/sampleapp/examples/embed-onboard and filed INFR-9876 with logs.

dev-bot: Release scheduled: JS SDK v1.6.3 (patch) -> canary 09:00 PT tomorrow :rocket:

jess: Opening PR for mapping + pad type + integration test that accepts both envelope shapes. Will post link here. Thanks for catching this! :thumbsup:
